aboutPage.title: Passionate about the road, committed to your service
aboutPage.lead: We believe renting a car should be simple, fast and transparent. That is why we built a hassle-free booking experience that puts your comfort first.
aboutPage.p1: We started from a simple idea: offer a modern, carefully maintained fleet for every taste and budget, with clear prices and no hidden fees. Today we serve thousands of customers across Morocco with ever-renewed trust.
aboutPage.p2: From economy to luxury, our team is ready to help you at every step — from choosing the car to delivering it wherever suits you, with instant confirmation via WhatsApp.

faq.metaDescription: Answers to the most common questions about renting a car with us: required documents, deposit, payment, changes, cancellation and delivery.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before renting your car with us.

account.q: Do I need an account to book?
account.a: No. Booking is guest-only: pick the car and the dates, fill in your details in minutes — no signup, no account.

documents.q: What documents do I need to rent a car?
documents.a: You need a valid driving licence and a national ID card or passport. The minimum age is usually 21 with a licence held for at least one year.

deposit.a: Yes, a refundable deposit is required and varies by car category. It is fully returned when the car comes back in good condition.

payment.q: How are booking confirmation and payment handled?
payment.a: After you send your request we contact you via WhatsApp or phone to confirm availability and arrange payment and pickup. Your dates stay temporarily held until confirmation.

cancel.q: Can I change or cancel my booking?
cancel.a: Yes — contact us via WhatsApp or phone with your reference number and we will change or cancel your booking according to the cancellation terms.

delivery.q: Do you offer delivery and pickup?
delivery.a: Yes — pick up at the agency, at the airport, or at an address you choose. Enter the pickup location in the booking form and we will confirm the details.
